panels.title: Move — Daily kcal vs Goal
panels.description: Daily Move kcal (mart.goal_progress, Goal='MoveCaloriesPerDay'). Bars turn green at/above the 950 kcal goal, red below it. Dashed line marks the goal itself. Timeframe follows the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.date::timestamp AS "time",
       gp."ActualValue" AS "value"
FROM core.dim_date d
LEFT JOIN mart.goal_progress gp
  ON gp."Date" = d.date AND gp."Goal" = 'MoveCaloriesPerDay'
WHERE d.date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
ORDER BY d.date;

panels.title: Move — Goal Hits per Week
panels.description: Count of days each week that hit the 950 kcal Move goal (mart.goal_progress, Goal='MoveCaloriesPerDay'), against core.goals' MoveCaloriesPerDayHitPerWeek target (5 of 7 days). Green at/above 5, red below. Timeframe follows the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.week_start
  FROM core.dim_date d
  WHERE d.date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
),
status AS (
  SELECT days.date, days.week_start,
         CASE WHEN gp."ActualValue" >= gp."GoalValue" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS met
  FROM days
  LEFT JOIN mart.goal_progress gp
    ON gp."Date" = days.date AND gp."Goal" = 'MoveCaloriesPerDay'
)
SELECT week_start::timestamp AS "time", SUM(met)::numeric AS "value"
FROM status
GROUP BY week_start
ORDER BY week_start;

panels.title: Move — Goal Hits (Last 30 Days)
panels.description: Count of days in the fixed trailing 30 days that hit the 950 kcal Move goal (mart.goal_progress, Goal='MoveCaloriesPerDay'). Fixed 30-day window by design, independent of the dashboard time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "value"
FROM core.dim_date d
JOIN mart.goal_progress gp
  ON gp."Date" = d.date AND gp."Goal" = 'MoveCaloriesPerDay'
WHERE d.date BETWEEN current_date - 29 AND current_date
  AND gp."ActualValue" >= gp."GoalValue";

panels.title: Move — Goal Hits per Month
panels.description: Count of days each month that hit the 950 kcal Move goal (mart.goal_progress, Goal='MoveCaloriesPerDay'). Threshold at 22 is a derived approximation (5/7 of a ~30-day month) -- core.goals has no MoveCaloriesPerDayHitPerMonth goal to reference directly. Timeframe follows the dashboard time picker -- widen it (e.g. 6mo/1yr) to see more than one bar. X-axis is an explicit YYYY-MM text label (not a timestamp) -- the previous version handed Grafana a raw timestamp for irregular-width monthly buckets and it mislabeled every bar one month early.

targets.rawSql:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.month_start
  FROM core.dim_date d
  WHERE d.date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
),
status AS (
  SELECT days.date, days.month_start,
         CASE WHEN gp."ActualValue" >= gp."GoalValue" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS met
  FROM days
  LEFT JOIN mart.goal_progress gp
    ON gp."Date" = days.date AND gp."Goal" = 'MoveCaloriesPerDay'
)
SELECT to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", SUM(met)::numeric AS "Hits"
FROM status
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start;
